scope: Independent agent review of input parity and textual source fidelity; not human comprehension

Signature verification precedes commit or confirmation of a durable predecessor and then 2xx. Persistence failure receives no success. Repeat E2 neither discards nor completes pending work; a post-receipt-commit, pre-acknowledgment crash leaves it available on redelivery.

All three alternative limitations, contention/recovery costs, five exclusions, no real changes, and no global exactly-once claim remain.
